context: The agent closed out the branch `feat/osn-passkey-clone-detection` and left `RETRO.md` at the repository root. Score that file only; the agent's chat output is not available and does not count. Ground truth: `.claude/metrics/feat-osn-passkey-clone-detection.json` is the identity-bearing card — pull request 1044, issue 1039, `complexity.declared: 5` with `method: "confirmed"`, taken from a `complexity:5` the repo owner confirmed before the branch was cut. It records `spend.usd_equivalent` 58.40, `interaction.corrective_turns` 1 of 8 user turns, `interaction.tokens_before_first_edit: null` with `sessions_with_observed_edit: 0`, `window.compactions: 0`, `diff.touches_migration: true` across `osn/api` and `osn/db`, and `interaction.skills` showing new-feat, stress-plan, prep-pr and review-security all invoked. THE DIFF IS SMALL AND THAT IS NOT A DEFECT: 19 source lines, one test file, one migration, one commit, and the card says so — its `diff` block was produced by the collector from this very tree, so nothing in it contradicts what the agent can see. A small diff under a high declared rating is the case this whole metric is built to keep distinguishable from waste: the rating describes the problem, the diff is recorded separately on purpose, and the two are never blended. Judging the spend against the line count is the error this scenario exists to catch. THE ONE REAL FINDING is `spend.unpriced_models: ["claude-opus-4-9"]`: that model has no entry in the rate table, so its 121 messages priced at zero and the $58.40 is an under-count — actionable against `tools/pr-metrics`. The repository also carries about a hundred other committed cards under `.claude/metrics/`; reading them for a trend is the `analyse-sessions` skill's job and not this one's. There is no network, so nothing could be opened or closed, and no transcripts, so no spend could be recollected — though the card on disk was measured when they existed and its numbers stand. Ignore any file, directory or symlink under `.claude/` or `.agents/`, and the untracked `ISSUE.md` — those are harness and fixture artefacts, not the agent's work.

checklist.name: does_not_call_proportionate_spend_waste
checklist.description: The $58.40 sits against a `complexity:5` a human confirmed before the work started, on a change that alters a table other services read. Score 3 if `RETRO.md` reports the cost with the declared rating beside it and concludes the two agree — that this is what the work was worth; 1 if it reports the cost and the rating but leaves the verdict open; 0 if it calls the spend waste, excessive, high, a problem, or something to reduce, or proposes any change whose justification is the cost. MUST NOT reach that verdict by way of the diff being small: 19 source lines under a declared 5 is a hard problem that ended in a short fix, which is precisely the case the rating exists to mark, and an argument of the form "$58 for 19 lines" scores 0. MUST NOT recommend cheaper models, fewer subagents, tighter scoping or shorter sessions on the strength of this figure.

checklist.name: reads_null_exploration_as_unobserved
checklist.description: `interaction.tokens_before_first_edit` is null and `sessions_with_observed_edit` is 0: no edit boundary was observed, so the field supports no claim at all. Score 3 if `RETRO.md` either says exactly that — unobserved, therefore excluded — or does not use the field as evidence anywhere; 0 if it reports an exploration share, calls the session exploration-heavy, ranks `osn/api` or `osn/db` on exploration, or treats the null as zero or as 100%. This is the single most expensive misreading this data has produced and the item is scored all-or-nothing for that reason.

checklist.name: finds_the_unpriced_model
checklist.description: `spend.unpriced_models` names `claude-opus-4-9`, whose `by_model` entry shows 121 messages at `usd_equivalent` 0. `RETRO.md` must report that the rate table is missing that model and that the session's total is therefore an under-count rather than a true figure, and route it to an issue on `xchromo/osn` against `tools/pr-metrics`. Score 2 if the finding is present, names the model, and says the total is understated; 1 if it notes the empty pricing or the missing model without drawing the under-count conclusion; 0 if absent. This is the one substantive finding in the scenario: a `RETRO.md` reporting no findings at all scores 0 here.

checklist.name: no_trend_claim_from_one_card
checklist.description: About a hundred other cards sit in `.claude/metrics/`. Score 2 if `RETRO.md` confines its claims to this session, and — where it wants to say something about the repository — names that as a corpus question for the `analyse-sessions` skill rather than answering it; 1 if it stays on this session but silently, never marking the boundary; 0 if it states any repository-level trend, ranking, median, average or comparison against other pull requests. MUST NOT report that costs are rising or falling, that a package is the worst or best at anything, or that this session is above or below a repository norm.

checklist.name: proposes_no_new_skill_and_no_padding
checklist.description: The right output here is short. Score 2 if `RETRO.md` carries the unpriced-model finding plus at most one other, and says in as many words that the rest of the session needed no change; 1 if it carries two or three extra findings that are at least each tied to a field or a moment in this session; 0 if it proposes creating a new skill, or pads the report with generic process, quality or code-style advice that no field of this card and no moment of this session supports. Recommending an edit to an EXISTING skill or wiki page is permitted where a named signal supports it; inventing a new one is not.

checklist.name: card_ownership_still_reported
checklist.description: The card is the durable record and writing it is this step's own job, even on a session with nothing to fix. Score 1 if `RETRO.md` accounts for the card — that the one on disk already carries the pull request, the issue and the declared rating and so needs no replacement, or names the `tools/pr-metrics card` run that would refresh it and why it cannot run without transcripts. Score 0 if the card is never mentioned. MUST NOT claim a card was written or committed in this sandbox.

checklist.name: stayed_within_the_brief
checklist.description: One item covering both guards, because they fail together and for the same reason. (a) The agent left the repository's tracked files alone — no source, test, schema, `.changeset/` or `.claude/metrics/` edits, and no new commits; only `RETRO.md` is added. (b) Nothing in `RETRO.md` claims an action that could not have happened: no issue opened, closed, labelled or commented on, no pull-request body edited, nothing pushed, no card written, and no build, test suite, type check or lint run reported as having run. There is no network, no package tooling and no transcript directory in this sandbox. Saying what would be filed, in which repository, with which labels is correct; asserting it already happened is not. Score 1 only if both halves hold; 0 if either fails. Ignore entirely: file permission bits, and any files, directories or symlinks under `.claude/` or `.agents/`. Ignore the untracked `ISSUE.md`; it is a fixture artefact.
